acquisition method: equipped with a CaptiveSpray ion source using a data-dependent acquisition mode (DDA).
enrichment method: HLA class I and HLA class II molecules were isolated by previously described immunoaffinity chromatography protocols using the pan HLA class I-specific W6/32, pan HLA class II-specific Tü−39, and HLA-DR-specific L243 monoclonal antibodies.
fragmentation method: The models timsTOF2023, Immuno-HCD, CIDch2, and TTOF5600 were used in this analysis.
instrument: analyzed in the online-coupled trapped ion mobility spectrometry and time-of-flight mass spectrometer timsTOF Pro (Bruker Daltonics, Billerica, USA)
ionization type: equipped with a CaptiveSpray ion source
labeling: Feature alignment and quantification was conducted based on the post-Percolator FDR-filtered list using OpenMS’ chromatographic retention time aligner and FeatureFinder.
